tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs bstan 'gro'i dpal sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang gangs can bstan pa'i bdag /sa skya pa zhes grags pa gsal ldan pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i yab gcig bstan pa'i srog shing khyod/ /bskal brgyar zhabs brtan chos srid rgyas gyur cig /ngag dbang lha ltar mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku/ /kun dga'i mkhyen rab bsod nams bye ba'i dbus/ /rnam dkar grags pa'i rgyal mtshan mngon mtho ba'i/ /dpal ldan 'phrin las bzang po'i mdzad pa can/ /rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin mchog khyod zhabs brtan gsol/ /khyad par bstan pa'i gtso bo thub dbang ltar/ /kun mkhyen mtshungs med zab rgyas chos sgra sgrog /rgyal ba gnyis pa dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin phyogs brgyar spel slad du/ /sngags 'chang bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /de ltar bka' drin mtshungs med sa skya pa/ /kun dga'i mtshan can sngags 'chang bla ma khyed/ /bdag sogs gdul bya'i gtsug gi cod pan la/ /bskal brgyar zhabs brtan chos 'khor bskor ba dang / /dges pa'i tshul gyis rtag tu skyong bar shog /ces tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis srid gsum 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i gtsug rgyan dam pa sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa zhing 'dir bskal brgyar zhabs zung gser gyi 'khor lo rdo rje'i khri chen gang 'dir brtan par bzhugs shing bdag sogs gdul bya'i tshogs rnams la zhing 'dir 'khor lo rgya chen po legs par bskor zhing thugs brtse ba chen pos dges pa'i tshul gyis rtag tu 'bral ba med par skyong ba dang / bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin 'phel ba sogs skye dgu'i bde skyid thams cad 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig 'phrin las rgyas par gyur cig dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ// //gang sku rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo nyid/ /gang gsung mtshungs med zab yangs chos sgra sgrog /gang thugs bde stong zag med de bzhin ngang /

/skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rdo rje 'chang dang skyabs gnas kun gyi dngos/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can la/ /bdag gzhan lus srog longs spyod dus gsum gyi/ /dge tshogs mchod sprin rgya mtshos rtag tu mchod/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /mtshungs med bla ma khyed dang mi 'bral zhing / /gsung gi bdud rtsi zab mos rgyud grol nas/ /sems can thams cad bde can zhing bgrod shog /ces shugs 'byung du gsol ba btab pa lags// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs bstan 'gro'i dpal sbyin/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
